svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 6 (CUMULATIVE R486) · DOCUMENT CITATIONS, MCP MOCKING & BI-TEMPORAL MEMORY
ReadAnyDoc (Word-Cited Reducto Parser) + mcp-mock (5-Era MCP Server) + Mersad (Bi-Temporal Memory)
1. arpitpatel25/ReadAnyDoc (★11 · Apache-2.0 · Python/MCP)
• Drop-In Reducto HTTP API Replacement ($0.003-$0.005/page)
~200 MB Apache-2.0 CPU layout/OCR engine + your own vision key (Haiku 5.5 default)
Returns Pydantic fields + word-level BoundingBox(page, left, top...) citations
• 5-Benchmark Results (~4,250 Pages, No AI Judge, anonymized_reported)
olmOCR-bench: 84.2 (vs Reducto r-1 80.9) · OmniDocBench error: 0.081 (vs 0.095)
Layout block accuracy: 78.3% (vs 55.6% model-only) · FUNSD: 77.4 (vs 71.6)
Deterministic review=True & alternatives=True (0 Extra LLM Calls):
Code flags values not printed verbatim, ambiguous dates, crossed-out text & short lists
Trade-off: 20-50s/page batch speed vs Reducto ~5s/page; ideal for private batch pipelines
2. axium-lab/mcp-mock v0.1.0 (★12 · MIT · TypeScript/Docker)
• Faithful Across All 5 MCP Spec Revisions (2024-11-05 ➔ 2026-07-28)
Pinned endpoints (/2026-07-28/mcp, /2025-11-25/mcp, /2024-11-05/sse) + OAuth /protected
22 deterministic tools + request-level _meta["com.mcp-mock/response" | "error"] injection
3. amkkoussay/Mersad (MIRSAD / mirsad-mcp · ★13 · MIT)
• Local-first SQLite / Cloudflare D1 shared temporal knowledge graph over MCP
• Bi-temporal facts: nothing is ever silently overwritten across agents
• First-class Decision units (reasons + evidence + outcomes) with 0 write-path LLM calls
• Cross-agent contradictions quarantined until resolved by the human owner
💰 CLOSED-FORM FINOPS BENCHMARK (CLAIM-20261118-R6-READANYDOC-MCPMOCK-MIRSAD · 30K PAGES + 25K CI TESTS)
• Path A (Commercial Reducto API + Live SaaS CI + Vector Memory): $2,180.00 API + $3,700.00 labor (37.0h) = $5,880.00 / mo
• Path B (Raw Vision LLM + Custom Mock Stubs): $920.00 API + $1,600.00 labor (16.0h fixing 55.6% layout) = $2,520.00 / mo
• Path C (ReadAnyDoc + mcp-mock + MIRSAD SQLite): $115.00 API + $280.00 labor (2.8h) = $395.00 / mo (-$5,485.00/mo · -93.28%)
Annual Savings vs. Path A: $65,820.00/yr | Provenance: measured (GitHub), anonymized_reported (upstream), synthetic (FinOps, independently_reproduced=false), hardware capEx: not_measured
